deliverables: Secondary marketplace for listing, pricing, and reselling tickets with on-chain settlement
Per-event anti-scalping controls including price ceilings, transfer limits, identity-binding, and time restrictions
Custodial wallet onboarding inside Sellout's user flow with self-custody export
Organizer dashboard/tools for resale parameters, ticket lifecycle data, royalty distributions, and verification
Independent third-party smart-contract security audit with report and remediation
Public launch campaign, trade-show activations, public metrics dashboard, and final governance report
request.recipient: Anvil Development Agency, Inc. / Intersect as budget administrator under the TRSC/PSSC framework
request.what: Fund Phase 2 of a production Cardano-native ticketing platform operated by Sellout.io and built by Anvil Development Agency, including a secondary marketplace, royalty enforcement, anti-scalping controls, wallet onboarding, organizer tools, audit, and launch campaign.

claims.claim: Phase 1 of the ticketing system, covering on-chain event creation, CIP-68 ticket minting, transfers, and attendance verification, is already live on Cardano mainnet and was funded by Sellout with over $130,000 of its own capital.
The proposal requests 4,969,231 ada, stated as approximately $1,093,231 at $0.22 per ADA, over 8 months with milestone-gated disbursement and a 3% Intersect administration fee.

Phase 2 is intended to deliver a secondary ticket marketplace, on-chain royalty enforcement, configurable anti-scalping controls, wallet onboarding for Sellout users, organizer tools, an independent security audit, and a launch campaign.
Sellout is described as having 200,000+ registered users, 250,000+ tickets issued to date, and 350+ events annually at current cadence.
The proposal projects 12-month post-launch outcomes of 200+ events on-chain, 75,000+ CIP-68 NFT tickets, 150,000+ on-chain interactions, $6,000,000+ ticket revenue on-chain, and 20,000+ new wallets.
The Yellowstone Club 2026 concert series is presented as a contracted anchor deployment with projected $6M+ Year 1 Cardano-settled volume and tickets priced from $400 to $8,000.

The proposal commits to repay $1,093,231 to the Cardano Treasury through a revenue-share mechanism in which 25% of all fees are sent to the Treasury until full reimbursement, then 5% permanently thereafter.
The exact revenue-base definition and repayment cadence are not finalized in the anchor text and are deferred to M1 contracting with an appointed oversight committee.
The proposer states that all on-chain metrics will be independently verifiable through Cardano explorer data, policy-ID tracking, a public dashboard in M5, and quarterly Cardano Forum reports.
The proposer states that Anvil/Sellout have not received ada from the Cardano Treasury within the last 24 months.

summary: The document requests 4,969,231 ada for an 8-month Phase 2 buildout of a Cardano-native ticketing platform, with milestone-gated delivery, Intersect-administered disbursement, projected adoption metrics, and a proposed treasury repayment mechanism whose detailed revenue-base terms are deferred to later contracting.
